entry.title: docs(install): recommend isolated pipx/uv install to fix PEP 668 exte…
entry.content:
docs(install): recommend isolated pipx/uv install to fix PEP 668 externally-managed-environment

`pip install ahadiff` on a Homebrew/system Python fails with PEP 668 'externally-managed-environment' — not an ahadiff bug (any package triggers it). AhaDiff is a CLI app on PyPI, so recommend isolated installs (pipx install ahadiff / uv tool install ahadiff, no git clone) across all install surfaces: README en/zh, docs/index.html, USER_GUIDE en/zh, and the viewer (platform.ts, GuidePage, en/zh i18n). Adds an externally-managed-environment troubleshooting section + Windows PowerShell venv form; keeps the tutorial-video note truthful; makes APKG notes installer-agnostic; updates the optimizer-extra hint + its test. Verified: vitest 500/500, typecheck+build clean, test_optimizer 9 passed, Playwright smoke 69 passed across chromium/firefox/webkit, i18n en==zh 1750. codex adversarial + cross-review; all findings fixed.
